objective: Make the merged CPVS discrepancy-report utility consume the authoritative fixed-width Table 2 archive, generate a hash-verifiable report in the source-backed heavy workflow, and preserve the unresolved historical selection-rule claim.
previous_knowledge_consumed: PR #224 merged the report builder but its actual 11,602-row output had not yet been generated from the authoritative Table 2 ZIP, selected candidate IDs, and published Table 4 source.
Official CDS ReadMe J/ApJS/249/18 documents Table 2 ID, Seq, gmag, rmag, Per-g, and Per-r fixed-width fields; Seq is not a row ordinal.
Issue #170 remains blocked: 741,786 reconstructed candidates, 730,184 published members, 11,602 candidate-only IDs, zero published-only IDs; the four-field predicate is diagnostic only.

baseline.status: Preserve software release v1.0.1 and frozen scientific baseline v0.2.0. This work adds source archive ingestion/report verification only; it does not change model artifacts, feature schema, or candidate-selection criteria.

expected_improvement: Parse the official fixed-width Table 2 ZIP using authoritative Seq and documented field offsets.
Fail closed on malformed rows, duplicate Seq values, or an unexpected parent row count.
Generate the candidate-only CSV, JSON, HTML, Markdown, and manifest from pinned source artifacts in the heavy validation workflow.
Verify source/output hashes and the expected 11,602-row discrepancy report without treating it as scientific ground truth or a discovery claim.

correctness.before: The report utility accepted normalized CSV/TSV metadata but could not directly parse the official fixed-width Table 2 ZIP used by the scientific workflow.
correctness.after: Fixed-width Table 2 archive parsing and an integration regression test have been added; source-backed heavy execution is still pending.

reproducibility.before: The report utility was not wired to generate and verify its report in the source-backed heavy workflow.
reproducibility.after: The heavy workflow now invokes the report builder and validates source/output hashes and membership counts when derivation succeeds.

evidence: Added fixed-width Table 2 ZIP reader using documented byte offsets and authoritative Seq.
Added integration test with a synthetic fixed-width Table 2 archive and a Table 4 ZTF-name crosswalk.
Added report-generation and hash/count validation steps to the source-backed heavy workflow.

The full source-backed heavy run 40397098709 completed on the authoritative Seq parser. Parent Table 2 had 781602 rows; archive SHA-256 0f3ca5d4e71f674c38b3c08553c12cca0c32d2d31f776166ab29ce80a75cf138; evidence sidecar SHA-256 640a048fc9e40df6e1bdfc1bfcd58ac13ee00ca6aee68ca90e7c5992dbdf7944. It produced 741788 candidates / 11604 candidate-only / 0 published-only; exact membership remained UNRESOLVED.

Added a dedicated workflow_run validator for the current CPVS Seq heavy run; it downloads the immutable scientific-validation-heavy artifact, rebuilds the report from the exact parent/candidate/published inputs, verifies counts and hashes, and uploads a 90-day report artifact. This workflow will only execute after the current PR checks are green and the workflow exists on main before the heavy run completes.

Source artifact metadata verified from completed workflow 40397098709: artifact scientific-validation-heavy SHA-256 212f4192de530212bafe597d589c67c0778363e0dadc1f64c1b44e8f170eb426. The report-reuse workflow can be triggered from ci/report-reuse/* using this recorded run ID if the workflow_run event is missed.
validation.blocker: Generate and audit the report from the completed heavy artifact for run 40397098709. The report must include all computed candidate-only IDs (latest count 11,604), preserve the two-ID shift from prior run #38121913146, and verify input/evidence/output hashes. If the workflow_run consumer was not installed on main before the heavy run completed, provide a safe artifact-reuse execution path without redownloading raw data.

root_causes: The report builder's generic delimited-table reader cannot interpret a zipped fixed-width CDS Table 2 source.
The report builder had not been integrated into the heavy workflow, so source-backed report outputs were not automatically generated and audited.

findings: A report-generation utility is not a completed report deliverable; source-backed invocation and output verification are required.
Table 4 membership must be joined by ZTF object name mapped to authoritative Table 2 Seq, not by Table 4's internal numeric ID.
Matching membership counts does not prove the publisher's historical selection semantics; Issue #170 remains open.

open_blockers: Run unit/integration tests and all required PR checks on the current head.
Verify the report artifact built from heavy run 40397098709, including all candidate-only IDs and source/evidence/output hashes.
Keep raw-lightcurve review and external cross-match status NOT_ASSESSED unless separately evidenced.
Keep Issue #170 open unless the exact historical selection semantics are independently established.

knowledge_carried_forward: Do not weaken the fail-closed scientific gate or change the four-field diagnostic into a production rule.
Do not claim candidate-only objects are new discoveries.
Keep all raw data out of Git; retain only bounded reports, manifests, hashes, and provenance evidence.
Do not mark this lifecycle cycle complete before source-backed artifact verification.
